scope: One fresh single-D435i official_ego PX4/SITL calibration run. No formal N11-N16 count; preserve full failure/run data.

hypothesis.one_primary_variable: Planner local horizon changes from 5.0 m to 2.0 m; all other measured task and runtime inputs remain the same as #337.
hypothesis.basis: #337 was refused by the existing final spline velocity/acceleration gate after optimizer success. EGO source uses the local horizon to select the local target. A 2 m local curve may pass dynamics feasibility at the same 0.10 m/s axis cap, then EGO can advance the original 16 m global target through successive replans.
hypothesis.criterion: Native action succeeds at the original +16 m, +0.10 m height, +0.20 rad yaw target with 3.0 sim-s dwell; fixed-SE3 independent truth verifies <=0.30 m and <=15 deg for >=3.0 sim s. If reached, 600 sim-s bridge-active hold completes, candidate raw VIO max <=0.15 m / yaw <=7.5 deg, actual vector speed <=0.12 m/s, tracking <=0.15 m, map source/occupancy age <=0.4 sim s, freshness gates unchanged, no prohibited contact, final landed/disarmed.
hypothesis.termination: Any final-spline rejection/action failure, localization or PX4 freshness failure, sim clock stall >15 wall s/regression, watchdog expiry, bridge leaving ACTIVE airborne or contact failure triggers safe bridge-owned landing and report. The 600 sim-s hold starts only after the native full goal succeeds.

pass_conditions: All conditions in this report must pass; a successful initial spline alone is insufficient.
A failure before arrival preserves a negative conclusion for this parameter contrast, never a success.
This one run does not establish obstacle net clearance or count as N16 long-duration formal task.
